scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:fresh: pnpm run dev:clean && pnpm run dev
scripts.dev:api: set PORT=3001&& pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && set PORT=3001&& pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run start
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.build:api-server: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
scripts.build:veli-bilgilendirme: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter @workspace/veli-bilgilendirme run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm run typecheck:api && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server --filter @workspace/veli-bilgilendirme --filter @workspace/mockup-sandbox --filter @workspace/scripts --if-present run typecheck
